subject: chore(yarn): clean lockfile (#4556)
bodyLines: I used https://github.com/atlassian/yarn-deduplicate and ran yarn install again afterwards (https://github.com/atlassian/yarn-deduplicate/issues/5)
Basically what this does is remove a bunch of overlappign versions of dependencies, which will result in a faster install & smaller node modules
